cues.en: Here is an important fact.
cues.zh: 這裡有個重要事實。

cues.en: If a function is differentiable at a point, then it must also be continuous at that point.
cues.zh: 如果函數在某點可微，那麼在同一點也必須連續。

cues.en: Now, explaining and proving this claim is the main goal of this video.
cues.zh: 解釋並證明這個主張，是這支影片的主要目標。

cues.en: And before I get to that, I'm also going to remind you of a couple of properties of limits that are relevant for this proof and also relevant for the next video.
cues.zh: 在那之前，也會複習幾個極限性質，和這個證明，以及下一支影片都有關。

cues.en: And then after that, we are going to turn this statement around and ask whether continuity also implies differential ability.
cues.zh: 之後，再把敘述反過來，問連續是否也能推出可微。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So, yeah, here is the statement again of the theorem, which is really just the title of this video.
cues.zh: 這裡再陳述一次定理，其實就是影片標題。

cues.en: So yeah, if a if a derivative exists at a point, then the function is also continuous at that same point.
cues.zh: 如果某點有導數，那麼函數在同一點也連續。

cues.en: Now, I just want to remind you that this is a statement about a specific point, not the entire function.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這是對特定點的敘述，不是整個函數。

cues.en: And that's because a function can be continuous in some subdomains and discontinuous at other points.
cues.zh: 因為函數可能在某些子定義域連續，在其他點卻不連續。

cues.en: And derivatives can also exist at some points in a function and not at other points.
cues.zh: 導數也可能在函數某些點存在，其他點不存在。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So before proving that claim, I want to quickly remind you of two properties of limits.

cues.en: Nothing new in this slide.
cues.zh: 這張投影片沒有新東西。

cues.en: Just a couple of reminders that you will use for this and the next video.

cues.en: The first one is at the limit of x as x goes to a is just a.
cues.zh: 第一，x 趨近 a 時，x 的極限就是 a。

cues.en: So for example, the limit as x goes to two of x is just two.
cues.zh: 例如，x 趨近 2 時，x 的極限就是 2。

cues.en: Well, that is kind of trivial, but I did want to have this as a reminder, because sometimes in math people get confused by trivial statements because you're expecting something more complicated.
cues.zh: 這有點顯而易見，但還是想提醒，因為有時人們在數學裡，會因為期待更複雜的事情，反而被簡單敘述弄糊塗。

cues.en: But anyway, this is one of the properties of limits.
cues.zh: 總之，這是極限性質之一。

cues.en: Second is that if you compute an additive term as the limit goes to zero, then that term just disappears.
cues.zh: 第二，如果在某個相加項趨近零時取極限，那一項就會消失。

cues.en: So the limit of F of X plus H as H goes to zero equals F of x.
cues.zh: 所以 h 趨近零時，f(x+h) 的極限等於 f(x)。

cues.en: This property here is more relevant for the next video where we will prove the power rule.
cues.zh: 這個性質比較和下一支影片有關，到時要證明冪次法則。

cues.en: But well, I just wanted to take this opportunity to remind you about both of these limits here.
cues.zh: 只是想趁這個機會，同時提醒這兩個極限。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: With that out of the way, let's get to the proof.
cues.zh: 說完這些，開始證明。

cues.en: The proof that differential ability implies continuity relies on one assumption and on the definition of continuity.
cues.zh: 可微能推出連續的證明，依據一個假設與連續性的定義。

cues.en: The assumption is that the function actually is differentiable at point A So we are assuming that this
cues.zh: 假設就是，函數在 a 點確實可微。所以假設

cues.en: function F of X at point A does have a derivative at point A, so F prime of A exists.
cues.zh: f(x) 在 a 點有導數，也就是 f′(a) 存在。

cues.en: That's our assumption.
cues.zh: 這是我們的假設。

cues.en: And then we start with this fact.
cues.zh: 再從這個事實開始。

cues.en: This is just the definition of continuity.
cues.zh: 這只是連續性的定義。

cues.en: So the definition of continuity is that the limit as X approaches a of F of x is equal to F of a OC.
cues.zh: 定義是，x 趨近 a 時，f(x) 的極限等於 f(a)。

cues.en: Now there's a couple of tricks.

cues.en: There's two tricks to solving this proof.
cues.zh: 證明有兩招。

cues.en: One is kind of easy and the other one is, I don't know, not super difficult, but not something you'd really think up on your own.
cues.zh: 一個比較簡單，另一個，我不知道，也不算超難，但不太會自己想到。

cues.en: Okay, so anyway, the first trick is just to set this equation to zero by subtracting F of A from both sides of the equation.
cues.zh: 第一招，就是等號兩邊減 f(a)，把方程式設成零。

cues.en: So we subtract F of A, we end up zero with zero on the right hand side.
cues.zh: 減 f(a)，右邊就得到零。

cues.en: And here we have the limit of F of x minus F of a.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 f(x) 減 f(a) 的極限。

cues.en: Now this term here F of A is basically a constant inside this limit expression, and that's because
cues.zh: f(a) 在這個極限式裡，基本上是常數，因為

cues.en: there is no X term in this function here.
cues.zh: 這個函數項裡沒有 x。

cues.en: This is a function of X of course, but we're substituting a in for x.
cues.zh: 當然，它原本是 x 的函數，但我們用 a 代替 x。

cues.en: So therefore this is basically just a constant when thinking about the limit of x going to some other value.
cues.zh: 所以考慮 x 趨近某個值的極限時，這基本上就是常數。

cues.en: Now for the next trick.
cues.zh: 下一招。

cues.en: The next trick is to take this expression and multiply and divide by x minus a.
cues.zh: 把這個式子乘上 x 減 a，再除以 x 減 a。

cues.en: Now, you've seen this kind of trick several times before and it's basically just multiplying by one, but we're expressing one as something divided by itself.
cues.zh: 之前看過好幾次這類技巧，基本上就是乘 1，但把 1 表示成某個量除以自己。

cues.en: In this case, x minus a divided by x minus a.
cues.zh: 這裡就是 (x−a)/(x−a)。

cues.en: But this step does allow us to do an interesting reformulation of this limit expression, and that is to utilize the multiplicative property of limits.
cues.zh: 不過這一步，讓我們可以有趣地改寫極限式，利用極限的乘法性質。

cues.en: And so we're going to break up this term into two limits the product of two limits instead of the limit of two products.
cues.zh: 所以把這項拆成兩個極限的乘積，而不是兩項乘積的極限。

cues.en: And that looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So we have the limit as X approaches A of F of X minus five divided by x minus a times the limit as
cues.zh: 有 x 趨近 a 時，[f(x)−f(a)]/(x−a) 的極限，乘以

cues.en: x approaches A of x minus a and the product of those two limits.
cues.zh: x 趨近 a 時，x−a 的極限，而兩個極限的乘積

cues.en: Equals zero.
cues.zh: 等於零。

cues.en: Now, this first term here is literally just the derivative of F of X at point A.
cues.zh: 第一項就正是 f(x) 在 a 點的導數。

cues.en: Now, it looks a little bit different from how we normally formulate the derivative.
cues.zh: 和平常寫導數的形式稍微不同。

cues.en: But notice that it's just the change in Y divided by the change in x, So the change in the function
cues.zh: 但注意，仍然是 y 變化量，除以 x 變化量，也就是函數

cues.en: output or the function value divided by the change in the x axis coordinate.
cues.zh: 輸出、函數值的變化，除以 x 軸座標的變化。

cues.en: And now we have the limit as x approaches A, which means that the denominator here terms.
cues.zh: 現在取 x 趨近 a 的極限，表示分母這個項，

cues.en: So D x is actually approaching zero.
cues.zh: 也就是 dx，實際上正在趨近零。

cues.en: So this is basically like saying H goes to zero.
cues.zh: 所以基本上就像 h 趨近零。

cues.en: And then we have this term here we're just expressing H as x minus a.
cues.zh: 這裡只是把 h 表示成 x−a。

cues.en: So this first term is just the derivative of X, and then we have this term.
cues.zh: 所以第一項就是導數，接著還有這一項。

cues.en: And what does that term equal to?
cues.zh: 那一項等於多少？

cues.en: Well, we have the limit of x minus a as x goes to a, so that's just going to reduce to a minus A which is zero.
cues.zh: x 趨近 a 時，x−a 的極限，會簡化成 a 減 a，也就是零。

cues.en: So this term here ends up being zero.
cues.zh: 所以這項最後是零。

cues.en: So we can write this out, this expression out as F prime of x times zero equals zero.
cues.zh: 可以把整個式子寫成 f′(x) 乘零，等於零。

cues.en: Now that's obviously true.
cues.zh: 這顯然為真。

cues.en: Zero equals zero.
cues.zh: 零等於零。

cues.en: And that means that all of these previous equations must be true.
cues.zh: 表示前面所有方程式都必須成立。

cues.en: And well, this is the proof.
cues.zh: 這就是證明。

cues.en: All of the statements on this slide are true, including the assumption that F of a our f of x at point
cues.zh: 投影片所有敘述都為真，包括 f(a)，或者說 f(x) 在

cues.en: A exists, and therefore the function is continuous at that point a.
cues.zh: a 點存在的假設，所以函數在 a 點連續。

cues.en: Now, very often in mathematics, certainly not always, but quite often you can turn expressions around,
cues.zh: 數學裡很常見，當然不是永遠，但經常能把式子反過來，

cues.en: you know, if two plus two equals four, then you can also say that four equals two plus two.
cues.zh: 例如 2 加 2 等於 4，也可以說 4 等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: So the question here is whether we can turn this theorem around.
cues.zh: 所以問題是，能不能把這個定理反過來？

cues.en: Now, we've already proven that differential ability implies continuity.
cues.zh: 已經證明可微能推出連續。

cues.en: The question here is whether continuity implies differential ability.
cues.zh: 問題是，連續能推出可微嗎？

cues.en: So if a function is continuous at some point, does that mean that the derivative also exists at that same point?
cues.zh: 如果函數在某點連續，表示導數在同一點也存在嗎？

cues.en: Now, if you'd like to think about this a question for a moment, then feel free to pause the video before I give the answer.
cues.zh: 如果想思考一下，可以在我給答案前暫停影片。

cues.en: So the answer is nope.
cues.zh: 答案是不行。

cues.en: This is a one way theorem, meaning that differential ability implies continuity, but continuity does not imply differential ability.
cues.zh: 這是單向定理，可微能推出連續，但連續不能推出可微。

cues.en: In fact, we don't need to use a series of equations to prove this negative.
cues.zh: 其實，不需要用一連串方程式證明這個否定。

cues.en: We only need to provide one example where the claim fails and one example out of many.
cues.zh: 只需要提供一個主張失敗的例子，而很多例子裡，

cues.en: But one particular example is the absolute value function.
cues.zh: 其中一個就是絕對值函數。

cues.en: So here's the plot of F of x equals the absolute value of x.
cues.zh: 這裡是 f(x)=|x| 的圖。

cues.en: So here at X equals zero, there's a sudden transition.
cues.zh: x 等於零時，有個突然的轉變。

cues.en: Now this function has a slope of minus one here, and then it suddenly transitions to a slope of plus one.
cues.zh: 這裡斜率是負 1，突然轉成正 1。

cues.en: So this function is continuous.
cues.zh: 函數連續。

cues.en: It's defined for all values of x, including x equals zero.
cues.zh: 對所有 x 都有定義，包括 x 等於零。

cues.en: So this function is continuous at x equals zero, but is not differentiable at x equals zero.
cues.zh: 所以 x 等於零時，函數連續，卻不可微。

cues.en: And why not?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Why doesn't the derivative exist at this point?
cues.zh: 為什麼這點的導數不存在？

cues.en: Well, I'm going to tell you the answer in a moment.
cues.zh: 我等一下會說答案。

cues.zh: 不過也鼓勵你暫停影片，想一下。

cues.en: So remember that for the derivative to exist, the limit needs to be the same from both sides.

cues.en: Now, I'm not referring to the limit of the function, but the limit in the definition of the derivative.
cues.zh: 我指的不是函數的極限，而是導數定義裡的極限。

cues.en: So the limit for the derivative needs to exist and be the same coming from the left and coming from the right.
cues.zh: 所以導數的極限需要存在，而且從左側和右側過來，必須相同。

cues.en: And if you work through the derivative of this function, you'll end up with the absolute value of H over H.

cues.en: And so the two one sided limits both exist, but they are not equal to each other.
cues.zh: 兩個單側極限都存在，但不相等。

cues.en: This one is minus one and then plus one.
cues.zh: 一個是負 1，另一個是正 1。

cues.en: And we can also think about this geometrically.
cues.zh: 也可以用幾何來想。

cues.en: So question is how would you draw the tangent line to this function at exactly x equals zero?
cues.zh: 該怎麼畫這個函數在 x 恰好等於零的切線？

cues.en: Well, there isn't a single tangent line that you could draw, could look like this.
cues.zh: 沒有唯一一條可以畫出的切線，可以像這樣，

cues.zh: 可以是水平，也可以像這樣或這樣。

cues.en: There's lots and lots of tangent lines that could possibly be drawn at exactly x equals zero.
cues.zh: 在 x 恰好等於零時，有很多很多可能畫出的切線。

cues.en: Anyway, the point of this slide is to provide a counterexample to prove by counterexample that a function can be continuous at a point without being differentiable at that point.
